description: "Delete everywhere": delete every published post from one batch (one compose or repurpose action sent to several accounts) from all of its platforms. Each platform is attempted separately and reported separately; some platforms (e.g. TikTok) have no delete API and need manual clean-up. Cannot be undone — get the user's explicit approval first.

post_batch_id.description: Batch UUID — post_batch_id from list_posts, or postBatchId from revert_post.

name: revert_post_batch
